hook: Not AI: Tesla's Roadster drives up a wall and onto the ceiling.
caption:
Not AI: Tesla's Roadster drives up a wall and onto the ceiling.

Tesla showed this in a livestream on 15 Oct. The on-screen telemetry reads 4,697 kg of downforce with the car at a 170-degree pitch.

Watch it twice. The second time, read the numbers on screen.

Did you think it was AI on the first watch? 👇

Follow @aiplaybooks.daily for one AI-or-real check a day.

Send this to the friend who swears AI made it.

Credit: @bindureddy on X
